children: NEW YORK, Oct 15 (Reuters) - The amount of U.S. commercial paper contracted in the week ended Oct 14 Federal Reserve data showed on Thursday.    U.S. seasonally adjusted commercial paper outstanding fell $5.7 billion to $1.480 trillion in the latest week.    Non-seasonally adjusted commercial paper outstanding - which some analysts consider a more reliable reading than the seasonally adjusted one since it has been distorted by the financial crisis - fell $1.3 billion to $1.446 trillion.    U.S. non-seasonally adjusted foreign financial commercial paper outstanding fell $16.8 billion to $346.6 billion.
